text:
tara: Heads up — intermittent token collapse on awq-hybrid (gpt-j-6b) after today's bake. Seen on canary ~10% of requests. group_size=64 + act-quant enabled looks correlated. Anyone else seeing spikes?

james: Yup, noticed ~2pm PST. Perplexity jumped then samples started repeating. Put a quick grep of logs:
```
2026-03-18T14:07:12Z INFO request_id=abcd1234 model=gpt-j-6b variant=awq-hybrid group=64 actq=on tokens=512 -> repeated token sequence at step 78
```

liu: Repro on my side with local runner in ~5/20 runs. Disables when group=32. Can reproduce with prefix len ~800-1200.

dana: Could be KV cache eviction interaction with AWQ act quant thresholds. We saw similar when prefix caching knocked over kv prealloc. Quick question: is this only when streaming?

james: Mostly streaming, yes. Non-streaming requests occasionally too but rarer. Example bad output (truncated):
"I am an assistant I am an assistant I am an assistant..." -> collapse after repeated phrase.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-18-14:00 completed for awq-hybrid/gpt-j-6b :rocket:

tara: Reverted canary to last stable (group=32, actq=off) at 14:20, error rate dropped back to baseline.

eng-bot: created incident INC-2026-03-AWQ-FLAKY, assigned to eng-ml oncall.

dana: I'll run a parameter sweep: group_sizes=[16,32,48] actq_thresholds=[0.4,0.6,0.8] with and without streaming, plus prefix lengths [256,512,1024]. Starting in 15m and will post results. I'll also test disabling prefix cache to isolate.

liu: Quick config snippet I'm using to repro locally:
```yaml
model: gpt-j-6b
variant: awq-hybrid
group_size: 64
act_quant: true
actq_threshold: 0.6
prefix_cache: enabled
streaming: true
```

james: Suggestion: add a canary guard to auto-disable act-quant when prefix_len > 768 or when response tokens > 400. Saves rollback cycles.

tara: Good idea — can we add runtime flag `awq.disable_actq_on_long_prefix=true` and flip in canary? Dana, can you test behavior with that enabled in sweep?

dana: Yep, will include it. Also capturing full traces + model KV hit rates. Will attach a table of failure counts per bucket once done.

liu: I'm also prepping small eval harness (200 prompt pairs focused on long-context behaviors) to baseline FP8 vs AWQ vs GPTQ. Will push results into the bakeoff dashboard.

james: Logged a quick note: sample-level neq metric spikes right before collapse. Saving a small trace bundle under s3://redwood-testing/awq-flaky/1729123456-traces.tar.gz

tara: Cool. Action items: (1) Dana sweep + logs, (2) Liu run eval harness, (3) James add temporary canary guard. Ping me when we have a bucket that still fails.

dana: on it. ETA first pass ~45m.

james: Thanks — will monitor and add alerts to the canary dashboard. :thumbsup:
